text:
alex: FYI we're planning an ABI bump + quant build swap tonight: engine kernel v4.0 -> v4.1 (quant-v5). Target swap 02:00 UTC in the quiet window. This includes the new matmul microkernel.

tanya: who owns smoke and quick evals? any known incompatibilities with older drivers?

alex: joel owns smoke. priya will run the small eval suite. Nate on infra. Docs/sam please prep a short release note blurb and a pin/unpin snippet.

joel: smoke plan: 5x short-gen (64 tokens), 3x chat continuity tests, run perf microbench against matmul path. pass if p99 < baseline+25% and error < 0.6%. Script:
```bash
# quick smoke harness
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-infer/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"quant-kernel:4.1","input":"smoke $i"}' | jq .status
done
done
```
I'll post summary at T+6m.

priya: eval plan: top-10 regression set, BLEU-ish metrics for structured outputs. Rollback if quality delta > 3%. Will run at T+5m.

nate: infra thresholds: GPU temp < 79C, p99 latency < baseline+25%, no increases in kernel OOMs. If node-level mem > 85% or OoM, we isolate node and pin.

ops-bot: Reminder: quiet window apac-east 01:50-03:30 UTC. Keep on-call pagers up.

deploybot: Deploybot: scheduled swap queued. Swap id sw-20240520-12. Pin command:
`/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:4.0 ttl=6h reason="night-abi-rollback-safety"`
Abort: `/deploy abort sw-20240520-12`

joel: smoke results (T+6m): 5/5 short-gen ok, p99 +18%, errors 0.2%. perf microbench shows expected matmul path. posting snippet:
```
smoke-2024-05-20T02:06:40Z p99: 254ms
smoke-2024-05-20T02:07:05Z errs: 0.2%
```

priya: eval T+5m: small dip on prompt #7 (2.7% regression) — below rollback but we should watch. full eval logs uploaded.

alex: ok start swap in 2m. keep tiny-slice 3% traffic until T+15m. hold bucket set: thermal-buckets 1 and 4 for 20m.

deploybot: swap started: swap-id=sw-20240520-12

~4 minutes later~

joel: post-swap quick checks: global p99 +22% (still under threshold), error rate 0.4%. However node node-cz-03 shows p99 spike and mem pressure.

nate: confirmed node-cz-03 mem at 88% and p99 3x baseline. No OoM yet but we should isolate.

alex: let's exclude node-cz-03 from rollout and pin it back to 4.0. We will NOT rollback globally yet.

deploybot: `/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:4.0 ttl=12h reason="node-cz-03 mem-pressure" target=node-cz-03`

ops-bot: Alert: node-cz-03 mem-pressure > threshold at 02:14 UTC. Routing update: node-cz-03 set to drain.

joel: opening exclusion ticket: infra/ops please confirm node excluded from LB and future waves.

nate: LB drain in progress, excluding node-cz-03. Telemetry now stable for remaining nodes.

priya: re-run T+10m eval: regression for prompt #7 reduced to 1.9%. All other prompts within noise. No additional infra alarms.

alex: decision log: keep rollout, tiny-slice -> increase to 10% after T+20m if no regressions. Node-level pin applied for node-cz-03.

joel: release-note draft pushed: includes notes about ABI bump, quant-v5 perf improvements, and the pin command example. Link: https://git.internal/release-notes/engine/2024-05-20-abi-bump

docs: I'll add a 'Node exclusion and pin' snippet + troubleshooting matrix. Will include commands and how to set target. ETA 03:00 UTC.

~20 minutes later~

joel: T+20m checks: global p99 +10% (back to baseline delta), errors 0.25%. tiny-slice promoted to 10% per alex.

nate: infra steady. node-cz-03 still pinned and drained. We'll run a follow-up health check at 6h.

priya: final eval at T+30m: no regressions above 2%. quality delta for top-10 average 0.9%.

alex: marking swap healthy for night window. Keep pin on node-cz-03 for 12h ttl then auto-unpin if stable. Create a postmortem doc template and collect logs.

deploybot: swap complete. swap-id=sw-20240520-12 status=healthy.

ops-bot: posting changelog note to #release-notes with link to draft.

docs: published release note draft to site and added the pin/unpin usage example:
```
# pin by target node
/deploy pin engine=quant-kernel:4.0 ttl=12h reason="isolate-node" target=node-cz-03
```

alex: thanks everyone. action items: joel/priya collect smoke + eval artifacts; nate keep node excluded and monitor; docs finalize release copy tomorrow AM with postmortem link if needed. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
